description: Configure the network interface {iface} with static IPv4 addresses 192.0.2.34/24 and 198.51.100.34/25. No default gateway is required. Activate the connection and ensure it is available after reboot.
hint: Review NetworkManager connection profiles and IPv4 addressing.
checks: p=$(nmcli -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show {iface}); test "$(nmcli -g connection.autoconnect con show "$p")" = yes; test "$(nmcli -g ipv4.method con show "$p")" = manual; test -z "$(nmcli -g ipv4.gateway con show "$p")"; nmcli -g ipv4.addresses con show "$p" | grep -F 192.0.2.34/24 | grep -F 198.51.100.34/25

description: Configure {iface} with 192.0.2.40/24 and a persistent route to 198.51.100.0/24 via 192.0.2.1. Activate the connection. Do not add a default route on this connection.
hint: Review nmcli IPv4 routes and ip route.
checks: p=$(nmcli -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show {iface}); nmcli -g ipv4.routes con show "$p" | grep -F 198.51.100.0/24 | grep -F 192.0.2.1; test "$(nmcli -g connection.autoconnect con show "$p")" = yes; test -z "$(nmcli -g ipv4.gateway con show "$p")"

description: Configure {iface} with the persistent static IPv6 address 2001:db8:40::20/64. Activate the connection and do not configure an IPv6 default gateway.
hint: Review nmcli IPv6 settings and ip -6 address.
checks: p=$(nmcli -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show {iface}); test "$(nmcli -g ipv6.method con show "$p")" = manual; nmcli --escape no -g ipv6.addresses con show "$p" | grep -F '2001:db8:40::20/64'; test "$(nmcli -g connection.autoconnect con show "$p")" = yes

description: Configure the connection on {iface} to use DNS servers 192.0.2.53 and 198.51.100.53 and search domain gym.test. Persist the settings and activate the connection.
hint: Review nmcli IPv4 DNS and DNS search properties.
checks: p=$(nmcli -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show {iface}); nmcli -g ipv4.dns con show "$p" | grep -F 192.0.2.53 | grep -F 198.51.100.53; nmcli -g ipv4.dns-search con show "$p" | grep -w gym.test; test "$(nmcli -g ipv4.ignore-auto-dns con show "$p")" = yes

description: Allow incoming TCP connections on port 18420 in the default firewall zone now and after reboot. The firewall must remain active.
hint: Review firewall-cmd runtime and permanent rules.
setup: systemctl enable --now firewalld; firewall-cmd --permanent --remove-port=18420/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; firewall-cmd --reload

hint: Each hextet has four hexadecimal digits; :: represents enough zero hextets to reach eight.
Remove leading zeros in each hextet and compress the longest consecutive run of zero hextets.

Compare the network portions using the supplied prefix length.

description: Determine an IPv6 /48 or /56 network prefix.
hint: A hextet contains 16 bits; each hexadecimal digit contains four bits.

description: Configure {iface} with static IPv6 address 2001:db8:40::20/64 and a persistent route to 2001:db8:50::/64 via 2001:db8:40::1. Activate the connection and do not configure an IPv6 default gateway.
hint: Review NetworkManager IPv6 route properties and the active IPv6 routing table.
checks: p=$(nmcli --escape no -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show {iface}); test "$(nmcli -g ipv6.method con show "$p")" = manual; test "$(nmcli -g connection.autoconnect con show "$p")" = yes; test -z "$(nmcli --escape no -g ipv6.gateway con show "$p")"; nmcli --escape no -g ipv6.routes con show "$p" | grep -F '2001:db8:50::/64' | grep -F '2001:db8:40::1'

description: The application on {iface} must use IPv6 address 2001:db8:70::25/64. Its existing persistent IPv6 configuration has an incorrect address and prefix. Correct it, activate the connection, and retain automatic activation on boot. No IPv6 default gateway is needed.
hint: Compare the active addresses with the persistent NetworkManager profile.
setup: {network_prepare}; nmcli con mod gym-lab ipv6.method manual ipv6.addresses '2001:db8:71::25/48' ipv6.never-default yes; nmcli con up gym-lab
checks: p=$(nmcli --escape no -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show {iface}); test "$(nmcli -g ipv6.method con show "$p")" = manual; test "$(nmcli --escape no -g ipv6.addresses con show "$p")" = '2001:db8:70::25/64'; test "$(nmcli -g connection.autoconnect con show "$p")" = yes; test -z "$(nmcli --escape no -g ipv6.gateway con show "$p")"
